data.persistence: IndexedDB; additive versioned upgrade; no automatic reset; explicit batch-only reset in Demo Chat preserves uploads and quota

limitations: No real provider/CAPTCHA E2E rerun; OAuth implementation unchanged and Production login remains disabled.
Browser IndexedDB fixtures and permissions are fictional; real D1/R2 authorization tested separately using explicit synthetic sessions.
Desktop Chromium and emulated mobile/tablet tested, not physical Safari/iOS/Android keyboards. VisualViewport handling needs device acceptance before real-user launch.
Cleanup invoked directly against isolated D1/R2; not evidence that a Cron fired or a full historical bucket inventory passed.
No scanner or staffed moderation readiness is claimed; synthetic moderation releases are fixtures.
Account deletion/linking regression is automated coverage, not a new Production deletion or interactive provider-linking run.
Setup initially stopped on an abbreviated expected-SHA assertion; subsequent final-cloud checks use the exact full SHA. New synthetic fixture accounts retained; all test sessions revoked.

resolvedPreReleaseIssues.issue: Final Production screenshot review found narrow-screen thumbnail overlap

resolvedPreReleaseIssues.issue: Initial album/quota response detached an already-interactive upload form, leaving retry controls disabled

resolvedPreReleaseIssues.evidence: Final isolated live test holds the initial response, checks no interactive form exists, then saves, loses acknowledgement and retries the same key.
